title: CSI - Grupo 4 ML
summary: A Spanish-language data pipeline that merges survey CSV files from a training program, detects metadata, and generates synthetic participant rows to augment the dataset with realistic Pre/Post/Eval training records. It uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to train on the merged data and generate additional synthetic rows.
